brier_role: reported as the second key probabilistic metric; it does not enter the rule
calibration_role: diagnostic only; never a selector or tie-breaker
eligibility: M1 is learned-signal eligible iff upper95CI(d10) < 0
M2 is learned-signal eligible iff upper95CI(d20) < 0
family_statistic: mean over the three frozen training seeds {11,29,47} of the event-equal VALIDATION NLL; never the best seed
interval: paired stratified cluster bootstrap over VALIDATION SOURCE EPISODES, stratified by VALIDATION layout, 10000 replicates, seed 20260821, 95 percent percentile interval
name: OPEN_LOOP_V3_FAMILY_SELECTION_RULE_V1
winner: CASE 1 -- neither eligible -> M0 wins; the learnability claim is NOT SUPPORTED
CASE 2 -- only M1 eligible -> M1 wins
CASE 3 -- only M2 eligible -> M2 wins
CASE 4 -- both eligible: if upper95CI(d21) < 0 -> M2 wins, else M1 wins by parsimony
